title: An organization records the release it runs and whether it is managed
description:
**Phase 4 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the account record story, in the provisioning epic
- **Runs in parallel with:** nothing. It gates the rest of this epic
- **Unblocks:** the ordering, update, and notification stories

---
Two fields, and the second one is the ladder made real in the data model.

**Release:** which version of Chatticus this organization deployment is running. Without it there is no way to answer what a customer is on, no way to order a rollout, and no way to roll one back.

**Managed:** whether this organization bought operation or only the code. A forked deployment is not in this table at all, but an organization that took self-setup and then declined the managed service is, and applying an update to it would be an unauthorized change in an account we do not own.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Managed updates

  Scenario: A provisioned organization records its release
    Given an organization provisioned into a customer AWS account
    Then it records the Chatticus release it is running

  Scenario: An organization records whether Anthus operates it
    Given an organization on the managed service
    Then it is marked managed
    And an organization that declined managed operation is not
